domain.note: s is local to this region's construction and is consistent with the project-wide convention w := sqrt(p) documented in docs/mathematical_conventions.md (shared with inflection_uniqueness_R2, universal_convexity_z, curvature_sign_change_general_R). It is NOT the w := R^(-1/2) used in theorem_4/05_upper_bridge's certificate; see proof/lower_endpoint_sign_conclusion.md, Section 1.

definitions.derivation_chain: F0 := s^4*H after substitution p=s^2, x=-1+s^2*Y (F0_full_pipeline.py); P := s^2*F0 in cancelled form (build_P.py), giving P = s^6*H exactly. The same P_built.pkl (the pickled symbolic form of P) is used both by this region's certificate and by the 02_lower_bridge mesh generator.

P_prime_at_0_is_0.method: direct substitution u1=sqrt(S1(s,Y)), u2=sqrt(S2(s,Y)) into P, then differentiation (method A), evaluated at (s,Y)=(0,1/2) and combined with Y'(0)

second_derivative_cross_check.method: method A (verify_Pprime_symbolic.py, direct substitution before differentiation) confronted term by term against method B (build_Ppp_chainrule.py, formal differentiation in 4 independent arguments + chain rule), at (s,Y,u1,u2)=(0,1/2,sqrt(2),1/sqrt(2))
second_derivative_cross_check.result: P_ww, P_wY, P_YY, P_Y agree exactly between both methods; P''(0)/2 recomposed via method B equals -9/32 - sqrt(2)/8 = -(9+4*sqrt(2))/32 exactly

P_second_derivative_negative.method: interval arithmetic (mpmath mp.iv), certified on the rectangle s in [0,0.00015], Y in [0.49987175, 0.500038475]

stationary_branch_existence.method: sign of G at the box edges Y=Y_lo, Y=Y_hi, certified by interval arithmetic for every s in the box
stationary_branch_existence.result: G(s,Y_lo) > 0 and G(s,Y_hi) < 0 for every s in [0,0.00015] (intermediate value theorem gives at least one root of G(s,.)=0 in [Y_lo,Y_hi])

stationary_branch_uniqueness.method: G_Y < 0 strictly certified by interval arithmetic on the full box (s,Y) in [0,0.00015] x [Y_lo,Y_hi]
stationary_branch_uniqueness.result: G_Y < 0 strictly throughout the box (strict monotonicity in Y gives at most one root for each s)

branch_inclusion.note: existence + uniqueness above together certify that the true physical branch Y(s) (the root of G(s,.)=0) is contained in [Y_lo,Y_hi] for every s in the box -- not merely assumed. This is the check that an earlier version of this certificate (certify_Ppp.py) did not perform; see certify_Ppp_v2.py's own header for that audit finding.

H_negative.result: H(s^2,x(s)) = P(s)/s^6 < 0 for every s in (0, 0.00015], from P(0)=P'(0)=0 and P''<0 on the certified rectangle

method.distinction: P(0)=0 and P'(0)=0 are exact symbolic identities (sympy, zero difference, no floating-point step). P''<0 and branch inclusion are interval-certified bounds (mpmath mp.iv), a logically distinct kind of result. The numeric evaluation of F0 along the branch in F0_full_pipeline.py (converging to -(9+4*sqrt(2))/32 as s->0) is corroborative only, consistent with but not a substitute for the exact symbolic identity.
